_doc: NARRATION (Phase 057): the sentence templates and labels the terminal interface prints (bigville/tui/narrate.py). Every line the player reads is a template here, filled with words from the agent view (phrases the view already holds, never a number). A template names the fields it fills in braces; domains/narration_check.py checks that each template names only the fields its key expects and that no template carries a digit. A digit can appear on screen only in a handle (a name the world uses, such as chest_1), in a menu number (the {number} field) and in the view's own text. The words are the pack's, so another pack gives another voice with no code change. APPROX: none of these is a world fact; they are display wording.

NARRATION._doc: Sentence templates by key. Braces name fields. The interface fills only the fields listed in narration_check.py for each key.
NARRATION.title: Bigville
NARRATION.reaction_intro: {from} is trying to take {what} from you.
NARRATION.reaction_amount: {from} is trying to take {what} from you: {amount}.
NARRATION.reaction_pick: How do you answer? Type a number or a word.
NARRATION.unparsed: That did not make sense as an action. Type help for examples.
NARRATION.map_hidden: You have not seen this ground yet.
NARRATION.still_waiting: The world is still waiting for your move.
help: Commands: walk toward the mill; work burn charcoal; take bread from Bram;
say Bram: good morning; smash the lock with the hammer hard; wait; look; sheet.
Words: gently, carefully, normally, hard and with all your strength set how hard.
Any other verb is passed to the world, which decides what happens.
Type a number to pick a line from the menu. Keys: hjkl or the arrows, . waits,
Tab turns the sheet, : starts a command, ? shows this, q quits.
